statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has a known history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study (CPT 93226) was ordered
The service was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The patient has suspected arrhythmic episodes
The diagnostic service directly supports characterization of the suspected arrhythmia underlying the patient's symptoms
The service guides appropriate management of the patient's cardiac condition
